title: Bike routes for commuting professionals - Capitol Hill, Seattle (Esri case study)
output_type: map + vector (proposed routes, half-mile coverage) + summary table
required_outputs: a map PNG (optional; the instruction names no file)
proposed routes as a line layer (captured or written)
method: Study area Capitol Hill (L_HOOD = 'CAPITOL HILL', 5 sub-neighbourhoods, 3.77 sq mi); employment centres = Downtown Office Core 1/2 zones; zoning overlaid on the neighbourhood for the land-use mix; existing trails SEGMENT_TY = 8 (6 segments, 5227 ft); arterial network SEGMENT_TY = 1 & ARTERIAL_C = 1 (6605 segments); corridors per the Instruction: East = MADISON arterials within 3.5 ft of Capitol Hill (E Madison St) plus MADISON arterials intersecting L_HOOD = 'DOWNTOWN' (Madison St downtown) (3.67 mi), West = 10TH AVE E touching it (1.23 mi), Central = 23RD AVE / 23RD AVE E / 24TH AVE E / TURNER WAY E touching it (1.64 mi); networkx shortest paths on the arterial graph confirm each corridor connects to the office core (0.25-1.75 mi); 2640 ft buffers, union, clip to Capitol Hill: 96.8 % coverage.
simplifications_vs_arcgis: Network Analyst replaced by a networkx graph of arterial segments (endpoints rounded to 1 ft) used only to verify connectivity to the office core
ArterialStreet OBJECTID = 3661 in the original model refers to a renumbered feature class and cannot be identified; West uses the named streets only
Traffic volume, slope and safety layers named in the instruction do not exist; no weighted overlay is possible
Demand 'hotspots' are not computed (no demand data)
benchmark_defects: The benchmark distributes only .lyrx layer files for this task; the inputs are taken from the data of the Esri case study.

The instruction asks for demand-hotspot clustering and a weighted overlay of traffic volume, slope and safety data; none of these attributes exist in the data. The gradable core is the corridor design given in the domain knowledge plus the half-mile accessibility metric.
The original model's OBJECTID = 3661 selection cannot be reproduced from the shapefile.
Writing projected layers to GeoJSON drops the CRS (labelled EPSG:4326); checks re-assign the input CRS to out-of-range coordinates.
checks: optional (the instruction asks for no map): a non-blank map PNG
required: a line layer of 0.5-2x the gold route length near Capitol Hill that covers >= 50 % of each of the three corridors (50 ft tolerance)
optional (as above): the map shows the proposed routes - >= 50 % of route segment bboxes match a drawn collection path / line

required: half-mile coverage of Capitol Hill: polygon IoU >= 0.85 with the clipped gold coverage (not the bare neighbourhood polygon) or a share in [0.95, gold 0.968 + 0.015] (scalars, dict entries, long or wide tables)
optional: >= 50 % of proposed length on gold corridors
required (the instruction says "Use Network Analyst to propose new routes"): network analysis in the executed code (networkx/osmnx/igraph/pandana/csgraph or a shortest-path routine; comments removed)
optional: existing trail length measured (5227 ft / 0.99 mi)
